2024 with HDA 2, so torque steering instead of angle
also, i typically use the car’s stock cruise control
so i can’t really speak for longitudinal

During the past day, I have driven for a few hours with this model. I had lagd and NNLC enabled. Here are some things I observed:
- Lateral is generally quite good with no significant line hugging
- It is able to make 90° turns better than any other model i’ve used. It sometimes is able to land in the correct lane and everything without help
- lane changes aren’t as great at lower speeds or in certain conditions. still, they are more gentle than many recent models. I think V2 is much more consistent here.
- a few times, during tight-ish right curves, it turned slightly too sharply and started to creep into the lane to the right.

I think this model is pretty good overall. I’ll probably keep using it until something I like more becomes available
